literal: Speaking before those who possess understanding is like pouring water in the garden bed of that which grows.
translation: Speaking before those who have the power of understanding is like pouring water into a garden bed of growing plants.
modern: விளக்கிக் கூறும் அறிவை உடையவர்கள் முன்னிலையில் பேசுவது, வளரும் பயிர்கள் உள்ள பாத்தியில் நீர் ஊற்றுவதைப் போன்றது ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet compares speaking before an appreciative and understanding audience to watering a fertile garden bed where plants are already growing. When you speak to people who can truly comprehend and value your words, your ideas will take root, flourish, and yield great results, just as water helps growing crops thrive. The word 'உணர்வது உடையார்' refers to those who possess deep comprehension, and 'வளர்வதன் பாத்தி' represents a fertile, growing garden bed. This highlights the immense value of choosing the right audience for one's knowledge.
